verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and connection platform, so asking whether it ships its own official MCP server is a fair question. The evidence does not show one. The page the probe flags (docs/use/connect) actually describes "a simple REST interface for connecting to MCP servers," which is a REST gateway to third-party servers, not a first-party Smithery MCP server. Uplink exposes the user's own server, and the CLI is a command-line tool, so neither qualifies. The hosted Connect and Toolbox services were also shut down on 2026-10-31, leaving only a non-proxied public registry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
